newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HKCB Bank buys HK$207 mln office property.
newsitem.headline: HKCB Bank buys HK$207 mln office property.

text.p: HKCB Bank Holding Co Ltd said on Friday it had agreed to buy three office floors in a commerical property in the Shau Kei Wan district of Hong Kong island for HK$207.5 million in cash.

HKCB said it would buy the 55,000 square feet of space in Eastern Central Plaza from third party Zebrine Investments Ltd at a price representing 16.6 percent of its consolidated net tangible assets as at December 31, 1995.
The deal, which is expected to be completed on July 26, will be funded by internal resources. The property will be used for office facilities, the company said.
HKCB Bank is the local banking unit of Lippo Ltd.
